name: magnetar
description: Magnetar — torrent search and download manager: a single-executable Rust client, a React dashboard, and a Cloudflare Worker for end-to-end encrypted remote access

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:client
scripts.lint: oxlint . && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test
